heading: Data is my
creative
medium.
paragraphs: I don't ship models. I ship decisions. Every forecast, every pricing curve, every supplier risk score is built backwards from a number someone in the business actually has to defend.
The interesting work isn't picking XGBoost over LightGBM. It's deciding which 12% margin lever leadership pulls on Monday — and proving the model earned that call.
Four years in, my bias is toward systems that survive contact with messy data, missing labels, and a CFO with a question.
